title: Love this picture included
text:
Love this picture included. This is super sturdy
No wobble at all and doesn't look cheap
I'm considering getting another

I love the slot I use it to hold my books next to the bed
Drawers aren't huge but they hold a good amount of items

Sometimes the instructions aren't super clear so pay attention and don't rush and think it through and it goes together very easy

Hint on rail tracks.... wheels are color coded ... all red on one side all blue on the other the same color tracks will align with each other

product_metadata.title: Sonoma Nightstand with Open Shelf, Cherry
features: Drawers run on smooth, all-metal roller glides with built-in safety stops
Open shelf cubbie for quick access storage
Dimensions: 23.25 in W x 28 in H x 16 in D
description: This stylish Tall Night Stand features an open shelf that is perfect for bedside reading material. Other features include two drawers, a profiled top, arched kick plate, solid brushed nickel knobs and drawers that run on smooth, all-metal roller glides with built-in safety stops. As a higher quality ready-to-assemble product it is made from durable composite woods. Matches other items from Prepac's Monterey collection. Weight Capacity- 75 pounds.
